This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted under the user-approved rule that duplicate rooms share one description. The selected description is the most common normalized WCCMP002 extraction for this room title.

records.description:
This narrow passageway is made of smooth white marble, polished to a
mirrorlike shine. Your every sound echoes down its length like a
thunderclap, it is so silent here. The passage slopes downwards at a
steady angle, heading into the bowels of the earth.

records.name: The Silver River, Northeast of Silvermere
records.description:
The rippling surface of the river appears to be molten silver,
shimmering mysteriously in the mist. Occasionally a loud splash can be
heard, quickly followed by strange shadows moving within the water.
The river flows very quickly downstream to the west, and is often
perilous to travel. The city of Silvermere lies just to the southwest,
shrouded in the mist like a stone colossus. To the north, a dark,
orbidding forest looms, and to the south is a plain of long grass.

records.name: Darkwood Forest
records.description:
This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

records.name: Sewer Tunnel
records.description:
This is a slimy sewer tunnel. A muddy stream of sewage flows through
grooves in the ground here. Bloated rat corpses and other, unnameable
things occasionally bob to the surface, and you are hard pressed to
keep down your lunch due to the rancid stench pervading the area. The
sewer is a filthy, unwholesome place, and it is hard to tell exactly
where you are in these labyrinthine passages.

and monuments dot the yard, and trees are planted in strategic
locations. Today, the tombstones are crumbling, the tombs are covered
in ivy and moss, and the trees have grown shriveled and black. The
ground suffers from some hidden disease, a malaise that eats at
anything living, until it sucks the marrow and lets it rot.

the town militia patrolling overtop on the walls. Estwall street runs

street runs to the heart of the city, ending at the town square.

This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted under the user-approved rule that duplicate rooms share one description. The selected description is the most common normalized WCCMP002 extraction for this room title.

This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted under the user-approved rule that duplicate rooms share one description. The selected description is the most common normalized WCCMP002 extraction for this room title.

This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

records.name: Graveyard
records.description:
This graveyard must have been beautiful at one time. Large statues
and monuments dot the yard, and trees are planted in strategic
locations. Today, the tombstones are crumbling, the tombs are covered
in ivy and moss, and the trees have grown shriveled and black. The
ground suffers from some hidden disease, a malaise that eats at
anything living, until it sucks the marrow and lets it rot.
omething brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

records.name: Darkwood Forest
records.description:
This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

ceiling are made of a dark grey stone marbled with metallic red

and a greasy cooking fire sits in the middle of the room. The long

covered with card games, miscellaneous clothing, and leather sacks.

onealed behind a partition, stands to the north.

records.name: Black Wasteland
records.description:
This vast bleak plain is covered in knee-high grass the colour of
soot. Great cracks split the floor of the wasteland, out of which
towering grey plumes of smoke reach towards the sky. Two moons, one
yellow and one blue, ride high above in the lavender heavens. There
are no landmarks save the moons, and a slight disorientating effect
pervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

records.name: Darkwood Forest
records.description:
This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

here even now, as a filthy nest-like pile of rags sits in one corner.

This haunting, claustrophobic marsh is filled a clinging mist which
leaves the skin feeling cold and clammy. Strange cries echo, muffled,
in the heavy air, and shadows move just beyond the vision. The ground
here degenerates into a murky marsh, filled with spiky roots and
floating clumps of moss. The water reeks foully with an choking, acrid
odour, but fortunately it is only knee-deep. The occasional feeling of
omething brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

leaves the skin feeling cold and clammy. Strange cries echo, muffled,
in the heavy air, and shadows move just beyond the vision. The ground
here degenerates into a murky marsh, filled with spiky roots and
floating clumps of moss. The water reeks foully with an choking, acrid
odour, but fortunately it is only knee-deep. The occasional feeling of
omething brushing against you leaves you feeling uneasy.

This long, low-ceilinged tunnel is supported by heavy wooden beams
that run up the walls and cross the ceiling. The tunnel walls
themselves are made of a brownish-red rock, run through with thin
veins of mithril too small to mine. Along the floor runs a metal cart
track, for use in moving mine carts along through the tunnel.
very direction, leaving the path to fresh air in doubt.
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

skirts around the southern edge of the swamp, far enough from it as to
be safe, but not far enough to escape the foul odour. The swamp lies
in a bowl-like depression, the path running up and around it on an
ever-rising earthen ridge. Below in the swamp, shadows can be seen
moving in the mist, and strange hissing calls echo mysteriously.

This is a dense, overgrown swamp, clogged with decaying vegetation and
evil-looking swamp plants. The ground consists largely of a rancid
soup, choked with dark mud and filthy water. Twisted black trees poke
through the surface of the bog, clutching like skeletal hands, and a
fine pearly mist cloaks everything in an unnatural silence.
ervading the area makes it difficult to navigate.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

is made of some shiny, almost metallic stone, and reflects the light

records.name: Cracked Plain, Black Chasm
records.description:
The earth here is dry and stony, and appears to have been broken by
some incredible force. It is heavily riddled with cracks of varying
size, some nearly wide enough to fit into. The uneven surface makes
footing a little difficult, but it is possible to pick a relatively
safe path. A gaping black chasm splits the earth to the west, so huge
and dark it seems bottomless. Anchored to two large boulders is a rope
nd plank bridge, which spans the chasm to the west.

You are standing on a narrow stone ledge, which is really nothing more
than a small section of rock jutting out from the smooth wall beside
you. It is only about a foot across at its widest, and small pebbles
fall away to the ground below you with each step you take. The sound
of what must be large waterfall is almost deafening, its echoing roar
incredibly loud in the grand expanse of this immense cavern. Peering
own in the darkness you can see a fair sized underground river.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

records.name: Lower Caverns, Entrance
records.description:
The stone of this huge cavern is marbled orange and grey, and is slick
with water trickling down from on high. Thick, fanglike stalactites
glisten from up above, occasionally seeming to move or loosen
as if they could fall at any moment. Flickering about in the darkest
shadows are twin pinpoints of red light-- the burning eyes of unseen
and malevolent creatures. A sloping passage heads upwards in a winding
piral here, and the treacherous cave continues southeast.

The stone of this huge cavern is marbled orange and grey, and is slick
with water trickling down from on high. The path along the cave floor
makes way here for a vast, gently rippling natural lake. Here a waist-
thick metal pipe snakes out of the dark waters, running across the
cave floor and into a black tunnel to the north.
rush you, when instead it is a mere pebble.

records.name: Darkwood Forest
records.description:
This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
pain, though this is surely not the case. The leaves are a dark green,
and are nearly as thick as leather. This part of the forest has not
seen many travelers as it is deep within the forest, far from anything
ivilized. The stench of ancient evil is very thick in the air.

floor has a slick icy surface covering it, and several shattered

strangers from entering the more sensitive areas of the castle. A

Each step up the path seems to test your stamina as the cold winds
blow down from the mountain top. You find yourself struggling to do
the long mountain trek, unsure of your destination, or of what could
lie in wait. You can only guess the path leads to the top, where the
black cloud blocks your view of the top.
ye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

Something about the way the light is swallowed by the darkness here
makes the caverns appear small. You almost feel crushed as if the
massive weight of the mountain above you were about to give way. With
each step the tunnel seems to grow smaller and you catch yourself
breathing shallowly as if to fit through a tight crevice. The dark
cavern leads onward, inviting you deeper into its maw.
imilarity of the passages makes it difficult to navigate.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

records.name: Undermountain Caverns
records.description:
The silence is oppresive here. Every step you take seems to be
shallowed by the darkness around you. Even the brightest light is
dimmed here, as if the stone darkens it to blot it out. You get an
uneasy feeling in the pit of your stomach, as if some great awful
something were to jump out and devour you in an instant. Your knees
begin to shake and you seriously question if adventuring was the life

records.description:
A series of rounded tunnels have been chiseled through the insides of
the volcano. They wind around in odd patterns, avoiding the heart of
molten lava. Traveling the insides of an active volcano leaves you
feeling so overheated that you have little energy. Your clothes are
thoroughly soaked in perspiration. Occasionally you find closed doors,
which seem very out of place. Thick steam flows through the air here.

murals representing the daily life of the deceased. Massive battles
play out along the east wall while the north shows the daily tasks of
the homestead being completed. The west wall depicts elaborate worship
rituals used to please the gods, some involving human sacrifices. Two
large braziers near the rooms center bellow large flames.

records.name: Sandy Beach
records.description:
A half moon shaped strip of sand lies between the water and the stout
rocky cliffs. The cliffs are steep enough that you are not able to
climb them here. The sand is a fine powdery white, contrasting against
the blue-green water. From here you can look out across the ocean. You
can barely make out another island to the east. A thick mist hangs
above the water and obscures your view.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

Magma still flows lightly through these deep tunnels. At times you are
avoiding steping into thin flowing streams, at others the magma is
dripping on you from above. It is so unbearably hot here, your armour
begins to meld to your skin. Every rupture and shake of the walls
promises a seering hot cave-in. You can barely see through the
thick mists and sweat dripping into your eyes.
ave been gouged into the walls. Bones and debris litter the tunnel.

evidence_refs.validation_policy: Accepted because the title was unique, or because duplicate-name file order matched all already-known descriptions in the group.

to have been cultivated here to protect you from the winter winds.  A
fire pit has been dug into the ground and lined with round white rocks
for food and heat.  The area is comfortable and would easily hold a
mid-sized tent.  It appears to have been used quite frequently.

records.name: Blackwood Forest, Hidden Camp
records.description:
If not for the smell of smoke, you might never have found this hidden
campsite.  A large firepit with smoldering coals gives off heat,
warming the area around it.  The coals don't give off enough light to
be detected by the road.  A large tent is pegged into the ground, with
no obvious entrance.  The remains of whatever was eaten as the last
meal, lay carelessly on the ground.

records.name: Ancient Galleon, Ship Bow
records.description:
Just being on this vessel runs a chill down your spine and a twinge in
your gut.  Judging by the gaping holes in the deck, this ship should

records.name: Crystal Lake, Inlet
records.description:
This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.

This lake was once known as Crystal Lake for it's clear and ice blue
water. The lake is fed with runoff from the local mountains and, on a
normal day, the water was without a ripple for as far as the eye could
see. The disease that seems to have effected the rest of the land is
prevalent in the lake as well. The water is choppy and erratic, and
tinged with an odd shade of red. Red mist whips across the surface
ike a beast, and the locals quietly refer to it as Blood Lake now.
